about: 200 bank statements, one customer's month each, made for a course exercise. No real customers.
duplicate_rule: A duplicate charge is a second charge in the same statement that has exactly the same merchant name, the same amount and the same date as an earlier charge. These are not duplicates: the same merchant and amount on a different date, also on the next day (for example a subscription or a daily fare); the same merchant on the same date for a different amount, also when the amounts differ by a few cents; the same amount on the same date at a merchant with a different name, also when the names are almost the same; and a refund, which is a line with a negative amount.
